reading: A restrained Edwardian country-house murder mystery centred on a death behind a locked study door, servant-class politics, suspicion, ruined reputations, and a wrongful accusation; the violence is off-page and inferred, with no profanity, gore, or sexual content.
rating_advisory: Recommended for teen readers (13+). Contains a non-graphic murder investigation, threat of wrongful conviction, and themes of social coercion, blackmail, and ruined reputations.
